name: Screen Capture
author: Ava
description: Capture this device screen into Home Assistant. One button, one camera frame.
detail_description: Take a screenshot of whatever is on the Ava device right now and expose it as a Home Assistant camera. Uses Shizuku/root screencap when available, otherwise Ava accessibility on Android 11+. Choose Small / Medium / Original image size in mod settings (not an HA entity) so the camera frame stays light. After each capture, Image URL holds a LAN fleet link (≤255 chars) you can open to pull the JPEG. Optional Last capture time sensor for automations.

config.label: Image size
config.description: Longest edge for the JPEG sent to the HA camera (portrait and landscape). Small keeps the camera entity light.

config.label: Last capture time
config.description: Expose last screenshot timestamp in Home Assistant for automations that need a fresh frame
